name: dogfood-vercel-ai-rag
description: Dogfood app 3 (v1.12-4) — a Vercel AI SDK + LangChain retriever + embedding + RAG pipeline that exercises document ingestion, chunking, embedding, vector-store search, retrieval and streaming LLM generation, drivable in both KIWA_MODE=real (Vercel AI SDK generateText / streamText against real provider + LangChain OpenAIEmbeddings + Pinecone-shaped vector store when RAG_VECTOR_STORE_URL is set) and KIWA_MODE=mock (@kiwa/ai-llm createVercelAiMock + createLangchainMock + in-memory vector store) so retrieval / embedding / final-answer fidelity feeds @kiwa/quality-metrics 11-axis release gate.

scripts.test: pnpm -F @kiwa/ai-llm -F @kiwa/core -F @kiwa/quality-metrics build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
